blocks.html: An ADU in a basement shall be provided with at least 1 means of egress exterior door opening directly to the outdoors in accordance with Chapter 10, including access to a public way. Such exterior door shall swing inward and be provided with landings on both the interior and exterior sides in accordance with Section 1010.1.6, excepted as provided in Section U202.8.4.
